title: Head of Customer Service – E-commerce Fashion (Refund & Chargeback Reduction)
description:
ABOUT US



We run a growing portfolio of direct-to-consumer fashion brands selling mainly to customers in the United Kingdom. We sell online through Shopify, and most of our customers find us through paid social and native advertising. Order volume is high, and every customer interaction directly affects our refund rate, chargeback rate and payment processor health.



We're looking for an experienced Head of Customer Service to own the full customer experience after purchase. Answering tickets is part of the job, but the main goal is to build a support operation that PREVENTS refunds and chargebacks before they happen.



Working hours: UK business hours (approx. 9:00-17:00 GMT/BST), Monday-Friday.





WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR



- Own all customer service channels 
, helpdesk, live chat, social DMs) and keep response times low

- Reduce refund rates by solving problems first: exchanges, store credit, partial refunds and sizing help before a full refund

- Prevent chargebacks and disputes by spotting at-risk customers early (delivery issues, "where is my order", slow replies, unhappy customers) and resolving issues before the customer goes to their bank or PayPal

- Make sure every customer conversation is clear, polite and well documented, so the customer never feels ignored or misled

- Track and report weekly KPIs: refund rate, chargeback rate, first response time, resolution time, CSAT

- Write and improve macros, SOPs and response templates with a focus on retention and dispute prevention

- Spot recurring issues (sizing, quality, shipping delays, unclear product info) and report them to management with suggested fixes

- Manage returns and exchanges end to end

- Train and manage future CS agents as the team grows



Note: You will not be responding to chargebacks yourself. Your job is to make sure customers are happy and heard, so they never feel the need to open one.





REQUIREMENTS (MUST HAVE)



- 3+ years of e-commerce customer service experience, ideally in fashion/apparel

- Proven experience reducing refunds. Please include real numbers in your application (e.g. "reduced refund rate from X% to Y%")

- A clear understanding of why customers open chargebacks and disputes (e.g. no reply, item not received, item not as described, refund taking too long) and how great customer service prevents them

- Excellent written English with a warm, natural tone suited to UK customers (including an older demographic)

- Experience with Shopify and at least one helpdesk (Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk or similar)

- Very organised, proactive, and comfortable working independently

- Stable internet, a quiet workspace, and a backup power source





NICE TO HAVE



- Experience leading or training a CS team

- Familiarity with order tracking tools (AfterShip, 17Track, ParcelPanel)

- Experience with UK consumer rights / return policies

- Experience in a high-volume DTC brand running paid ads





WHAT WE OFFER



- Long-term, stable full-time position

- Monthly performance bonus tied to refund and chargeback KPIs

- Room to grow into managing a full CS team

- Direct communication with the owner, no layers of management

- Paid time off and 13th month pay





HOW TO APPLY



To show us you read the full post, start your application with the subject line: "Head of CS - Chargeback Prevention"



In your application, please include:



1. A short summary of your relevant experience

2. A specific example of how you reduced refunds or prevented chargebacks/disputes, including numbers

3. Your answer to this scenario: "A customer
s saying the dress she ordered doesn't fit and she wants a full refund. She also mentions she will 'contact her bank' if this isn't sorted quickly. How would you respond?"

4. Which helpdesk tools you have used

5. Your expected monthly salary



Applications without the subject line or the scenario answer will not be considered.

title: Virtaul Assistant/Channel Manager
description:
Job Title: Virtual Assistant (YouTube Shorts Editor & Channel Manager)



Salary: $200 Base + Up to $300 Performance Bonuses ($500/mo Total Potential)



Type: Part-Time / Monthly Retainer





ABOUT THE ROLE:



Hello! I am a content creator operating a growing entertainment brand. I am looking for a reliable, skilled Virtual Assistant with video editing experience to publish comedic clips to your own YouTube channel(s).



This is a unique role: You will not just be editing videos and sending files back to me. You will be editing clips and uploading them directly to your own YouTube channel(s), sharing funny highlights of my content to your audience and the YouTube Shorts algorithm.



I will make this incredibly easy for you by providing the actual pre-cut video clips, not massive raw VODs. You will not have to waste any time hunting for content or downloading huge files—you just take the short pre-cut clip, add snappy, engaging edits, and post!





WHAT YOU WILL DO (THE DELIVERABLES):



    The Quota: Create and publish a minimum of 150 YouTube Shorts/videos per month (averaging 5 per day) to your own YouTube channel.



    The Editing Style: Clean, punchy comedic edits. You will take the pre-cut clips I provide, add standard engaging captions, basic zooms, sound effects, and relevant meme inserts to elevate the humor and keep the viewer's attention.



    The Branding: Ensure my brand's watermark/text is visible on every clip and include the designated brand hashtag in the title or description (specific details will be provided upon hiring).



    The Uploading: Upload and publish the clips directly to your own YouTube channel. Clips must remain public for a minimum of 30 days (leaving them up permanently is highly preferred for ongoing channel growth).





COMPENSATION & BONUSES:



This role is designed to reward you when your uploads perform well. All views must be 100% organic (no bots or sub-4-sub schemes).



    Guaranteed Base Pay: $200 USD per month for successfully editing and posting the 150 required clips with proper branding.



    Tier 1 View Bonus: +$100 USD if your clips generate 250,000 total combined organic YouTube views within the calendar month.



    Tier 2 View Bonus: +$200 USD if your clips generate 750,000 total combined organic YouTube views within the calendar month.



    Maximum Monthly Earning Potential: $500 USD





REQUIREMENTS:



    An active and established YouTube channel where you can publish these Shorts/videos.



    Solid experience editing short-form content (YouTube Shorts, TikToks, Reels) using Premiere Pro, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, or similar tools.



    Good grasp of comedic timing, pacing, meme integration, and engaging captions.



    Reliable high-speed internet connection to download the pre-cut clips and upload daily content.



    Willingness to sign a standard Independent Contractor agreement protecting both parties.



    Ability to maintain a consistent upload schedule (~5 clips per day).





HOW TO APPLY:



To prove you read this entire post and pay close attention to detail, please start your application with the word "HERO".



In your application, please include:



    A brief introduction of yourself and your editing/VA experience.



    A link to the YouTube channel where you plan to post the clips.



    Links to 2–3 sample YouTube Shorts or TikToks you have edited, ideally showcasing your use of captions and memes.



    Confirmation that you understand you will be uploading these clips directly to your own YouTube channel.

title: Full-Time DTC Video Editor – Skincare Brand | $5–$6/Hour + Up to $1,000 Per Winning Video
description:
We are looking for a full-time DTC Video Editor to join our growing skincare brand.



This is not a role for someone who only wants to make beautiful-looking videos.



We care about one thing above everything else:



Does the creative make people stop, watch, and buy?



A simple video that converts is far more valuable to us than a cinematic edit that doesn’t generate sales.



You need to understand direct-response creative structure: hooks, pacing, retention, storytelling, offers, CTAs, and why people keep watching or scroll away.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become part of the team, take ownership of their work, continuously improve, and grow with us long term.





Compensation & Bonuses:



Base pay is $5–$6 per hour, depending on your experience and skill level.



But your base salary is only one part of your earning potential.



We have a strong performance-based bonus system where editors can earn up to $1,000 from a single winning video.



In strong months, there is potential to earn 3–5x your base salary through performance bonuses.



When the brand performs better, we all make more money together.



We also offer:



- Performance bonuses for winning creatives

- Annual tenure / loyalty bonuses

- Additional performance-based rewards

- Opportunities for higher compensation as you grow with the company



We want the people who help us grow to benefit from that growth as well.





What You’ll Be Doing:



You will be creating English-language direct-response video ads for a skincare DTC brand.



Your job will include:



- Editing performance-focused DTC creatives

- Turning scripts, concepts, footage, UGC, B-roll, and AI-generated content into finished ads

- Creating strong hooks that stop the scroll

- Creating and integrating AI-generated video scenes

- Improving creatives based on feedback and performance

- Continuously learning what makes an ad convert



We don’t expect every creative to look like a movie.



We expect you to understand why an ad works.





What We’re Looking For:



Previous experience creating video ads for DTC / Shopify brands is REQUIRED.



Please do not apply if you have only edited YouTube videos, wedding videos, gaming videos, corporate videos, or traditional social media content without direct-response e-commerce experience.



You should:



- Have experience editing DTC performance creatives

- Understand hooks, CTAs, pacing, retention, storytelling, and direct-response advertising

- Have experience creating AI-generated video content

- Have hands-on experience with Higgsfield

- Have experience with ElevenLabs

- Be highly comfortable with CapCut and/or Adobe editing software

- Be able to work independently without needing step-by-step instructions for everything

- Be open to feedback and willing to improve quickly

- Have a strong desire to learn and develop your creative skills

- Be interested in a long-term position rather than a short-term freelance project





We Invest in Your Growth:



We’re not looking for someone to simply complete tasks for us.



We’re looking for someone we can grow with for years.



We have a large amount of internal training, creative frameworks, examples, resources, and educational material that we will share with you.



We continuously invest in new training and education, and we want to help you become a significantly better direct-response editor and creative thinker over time.



The better you become, the better our creatives become.



And when our creatives perform better, everyone wins.





Working Style:



100% Remote



You can set your own working hours.



We care much more about ownership, communication, deadlines, consistency, and output than the exact hours you choose to work.



We want a teammate who takes responsibility for their work and treats the brand like something they are helping build, not someone who simply clocks in and waits for instructions.





Hiring Process:



1. Short Test Task



A short unpaid test task that should take approximately 2–4 hours.



You will complete the test using your own tools.



You will have 48 hours to complete it.



2. Two-Week Paid Trial



If you pass the test, you will move into a two-week paid trial period.



During the trial, you will be expected to work a minimum of 20 hours per week.



The trial is fully paid, and from this stage onward, we will provide access to the paid tools required for the role.



3. Regular Contract



If the trial goes well and we are both happy working together, you will move into a regular long-term contract at your full salary, with access to our performance bonus system.





How to Apply:

(Please prioritize DTC / e-commerce advertising work.)

title: Logistics Virtual Assistant 30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr
description:
Logistics Virtual Assistant

30-day paid trial · Remote · 15 hrs/week · USD $7.50/hr

Chameleon Science Pty Ltd · Australia



About the role

Chameleon Science sells research reagents to laboratories across Australia and New Zealand, sourced

from suppliers in the US, Europe and China. We handle 7–10 customer orders a week. Every order has

to be quoted, ordered from the supplier, cleared through Australian biosecurity, held at the right

temperature, delivered and invoiced.

You will run that process end to end, following our Order Logistics SOP. The role starts with logistics and

can grow into general admin.

We are looking for someone who follows a process carefully and then tells us how to make it better. If

you spot something that does not add up, we want you to stop and ask rather than push it through.

What you will own

Every order, from the customer's first request to delivery:

1. Quote the customer. Build quotes in Xero with correct pricing, freight (standard, blue ice or dry ice)

and lead time. Send them and log the deal in Pipedrive.

2. Take in orders. Check each customer PO against the quote, acknowledge it the same day, and

choose the shipping route.

3. Order from the supplier. Raise purchase orders in Xero in the supplier's currency. Track

confirmations, backorders and ship dates.

4. Prepare import paperwork. Send suppliers our import permit and manufacturer's declaration

template. Check the signed declaration matches the permit word for word.

5. Pre-clear and track. Send FedEx the clearance documents, track inbound shipments daily, and

answer customs queries the same day.

6. Arrange delivery. Brief our Sydney logistics partner, book couriers before the daily cutoff, and

manage cold-chain and dry-ice shipments.

7. Invoice. Send one Xero invoice per order at dispatch, with courier and tracking number.

8. Close out. Record delivery, keep Pipedrive and the shipment spreadsheet current, and enter

supplier bills in Xero.

Across every step:

• Answer overnight supplier questions first thing, before US and EU cutoffs.

• Check the orders@, accounts@ and info@ inboxes every day.

• Keep customers informed of ETAs and delays before they have to ask.

• Flag anything that does not match — prices, cartons, paperwork — before acting on it.

What stays with Kathryn during the trial

These decisions do not route to you in the first 30 days:

• Manufacturers declarations — you check them, Kathryn approves each one before the supplier is

told to ship.

• Courier and freight spend — ask before booking or approving.

• Permit wording for new product types — checked case by case.

• Overdue-invoice chasing — not part of the trial.

• FedEx import freight and duty invoices — Kathryn codes these in Xero.

Logins to FedEx, Toll, Team Global Express, Logistics 360, Xero, Pipedrive and the shipment

spreadsheet are set up on day one.

How hiring works

Step 1 — Application

Send a short note covering your logistics or order-processing experience and the systems you have

used, plus a 2-minute video introducing yourself.

Put DRY ICE as the first word of your subject line. Applications without it are not read — this role is

about reading instructions carefully, and this is the first test.

Step 2 — Paid test project

Shortlisted applicants complete a paid 2-hour task built from a real order: check a set of order

documents, quote it, and tell us what to do next. Paid at the hourly rate above regardless of outcome.

Step 3 — 30-day paid trial

A paid, fixed-term engagement. It is a fair test both ways: you see whether the work suits you, and we

see whether you can run orders with less and less help.

The 30 days

Week Focus Done when

1 Learn the SOP, systems and partners.

Shadow live orders.



You can explain each step and know what

routes back to Kathryn.



2 Run quotes, PO intake and supplier POs, with

Kathryn checking.



Quotes and POs go out correct and same-

day.

3 Run import paperwork, tracking and dispatch,

with Kathryn checking.



Shipments pre-cleared and dispatched with

no missed cutoffs.



4 Run the full process end to end. Propose

improvements.



Most orders need no correction, and you

have proposed at least one SOP

improvement.



At the end we review together against four measures:

• Orders processed correctly from quote to invoice.

• Supplier and courier cutoffs met.

• Pipedrive, Xero and the shipment spreadsheet matching reality at the end of each day.

• Problems flagged early, with a clear question or a suggested fix.

If it goes well the role continues, with a long-term decision at around 90 days.

What you will need

Essential

• Experience in order processing, logistics, import/export or e-commerce admin.

• Strong attention to detail — you will match documents word for word and number for number.

• Clear written English for suppliers, customers, FedEx and couriers.

• Comfort working across several systems at once and keeping them in sync.

• Reliability with deadlines, and the judgement to ask before guessing.

• A process mindset: follow the SOP, then improve it.

Nice to have

• Xero, Pipedrive or another CRM.

• International freight, customs clearance or courier bookings.

• Cold-chain or dangerous goods (dry ice) shipping.

• Experience with Australian businesses or the life sciences.

• Using AI tools to work faster.

Terms

Contract Independent contractor, 30-day paid trial, extendable in further 30-day blocks.

Pay USD $7.50 per hour, paid fortnightly.

Hours 15 hours per week, Monday to Friday.

Overlap Daily start by 6:00am Manila time (9:00am Sydney) to clear overnight supplier


. Courier bookings must be placed before 12:00pm Manila (3:00pm Sydney).



Location Remote. Philippines preferred.

Start Monday 2 November 2026.

Reports to Kathryn Friend, Founder.

Systems Xero, Pipedrive, Gmail, Google Drive and Sheets, FedEx, Toll, Team Global



Express, Logistics 360.



Reporting A short end-of-day update: what shipped, what is waiting, what needs Kathryn.



Key dates

• Applications close: Friday 16 October 2026.

• Paid test projects: week of 19 October.

• Offer made: by Friday 30 October.

• Trial starts: Monday 2 November.

title: Senior Business Funding Strategist — 0% APR Credit & Revenue-Based Funding
description:
COMPANY: JJT Consulting Group LLC

LOCATION: Remote — Philippines

SCHEDULE: Full-time availability during U.S. Eastern business hours

COMPENSATION: Competitive base pay + commission incentives tied to successful funding outcomes



ABOUT THE ROLE



JJT Consulting Group helps U.S. business owners pursue capital through business credit and revenue-based funding strategies.



We’re looking for an experienced Funding Strategist who can independently assess a client’s financial profile, recommend suitable funding options, and manage execution from initial review through approval and funding.



You should understand how to evaluate lender fit, sequence applications responsibly, protect client eligibility, explain costs and risks clearly, and communicate confidently with business owners.



This role requires sound judgment, strong follow-through, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple client files without constant supervision.



RESPONSIBILITIES



• Review personal and business credit reports, business information, bank statements, revenue, cash flow, and existing obligations.

• Assess funding readiness and identify issues that could affect approvals, pricing, available limits, or repayment capacity.

• Develop personalized funding strategies based on each client’s goals, profile, timing, and risk factors.

• Recommend suitable lenders and products, including 0% introductory APR business credit cards and revenue-based funding, when appropriate.

• Determine application order, timing, preparation steps, and required documentation.

• Evaluate whether revolving credit, revenue-based financing, or a combination fits the client’s needs.

• Clearly explain promotional periods, fees, repayment structures, obligations, risks, and next steps.

• Manage applications through submission, lender follow-up, approval, closing, and funding.

• Verify documents and resolve missing information or inconsistencies before submission.

• Communicate proactively with clients and lenders through calls, text messages, and
.

• Maintain accurate CRM records, lender notes, application statuses, funding totals, and next actions.

• Follow company SOPs and communication deadlines, escalating issues when needed.

• Recommend improvements to application quality, client experience, and funding execution.

• Protect client confidentiality and handle financial information responsibly.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



• Hands-on experience in U.S. business funding, business credit, commercial lending, or a closely related field.

• Familiarity with both 0% introductory APR business credit card strategies and revenue-based funding.

• Strong understanding of credit utilization, payment history, inquiries, credit age, personal guarantees, business structure, and lender eligibility.

• Experience analyzing bank statements, revenue trends, cash flow, deposits, balances, negative days, and existing payment obligations.

• Ability to develop and explain a complete funding strategy independently.

• Sound judgment about lender fit, application timing, client readiness, and when to postpone or decline an application.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and ownership of deadlines.

• Confidence managing client calls and multiple applications at different stages.

• Reliable internet, a quiet professional workspace, and consistent availability during U.S. Eastern business hours.

• Ability to communicate funding terms accurately without making guarantees about approval, limits, rates, or timing.



Experience with GoHighLevel, lender portals, CRM systems, funding trackers, and document-management workflows is strongly preferred.



COMPENSATION & OPPORTUNITY



• Competitive base pay reflecting your experience and demonstrated ability.

• Commission incentives on successfully funded deals, allowing you to increase your earnings through strong execution and results.

• Clear performance expectations and commission terms established in writing before you start.

• Ownership of client funding strategies from assessment through funding completion.

• The opportunity to contribute your lender knowledge and improve our funding systems.

• Room to grow into greater responsibility as you demonstrate consistent performance.



Commission eligibility, payment timing, treatment of cancellations or chargebacks, and the definition of a successfully funded deal will be explained before employment begins.



We want a strategist who can deliver—and we want your compensation to reflect the value you bring.



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



• Accurate funding assessments and well-reasoned strategies.

• Appropriate lender and product recommendations.

• Complete, accurate applications and timely submissions.

• Proactive client and lender communication.

• Approval and funding outcomes relative to client eligibility, without sacrificing suitability or compliance.

• Accurate CRM records and reliable pipeline management.

• Consistent adherence to company processes, deadlines, and confidentiality requirements.

• Client trust, clarity, and overall experience.

• Responsible use of client information and accurate representation of funding terms.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with ALL of the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining your relevant funding experience.

3. A brief, anonymized funding strategy example covering the client’s general profile, funding objective, lenders or products considered, recommended application sequence, reasoning, and final outcome if available.

4. A list of funding products, lenders, lender portals, and CRM systems you have worked with.

5. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

6. Your expected base compensation.

7. Measurable results, if available, such as approval rates, total funding facilitated, average client funding, or number of applications managed.



Remove all client-identifying and confidential information from your examples. Do not include account numbers, Social Security numbers, full credit reports, bank statements, login credentials, or other sensitive data.



APPLICATION SUBJECT: Funding Strategist — Ready to Own Results



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Your application must include the Loom video, strategy example, relevant platform experience, availability, and compensation expectations.

title: AI Growth, Social Media & Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
About the Role



We are an international digital marketing and technology agency working with clients across different countries and industries.



We are looking for a proactive AI Growth, Social Media & Marketing Automation Specialist to join our team on a long-term basis.



This is a hands-on role combining social media, video, AI, lead generation and marketing automation.



We are not looking for someone who simply knows many tools. We want someone who understands marketing objectives, thinks across channels and can turn ideas into practical systems and strong content.



What You Will Work On



Social Media and Content



• Plan and create content for LinkedIn, Instagram,
, YouTube and other relevant platforms.



• Develop hooks, captions, content ideas, carousels, graphics and campaigns.



• Repurpose existing content into different formats.



• Understand how content should change depending on platform, audience and objective.



• Identify trends and creative opportunities.



Video and AI Content



• Create and edit short-form videos, Reels and Shorts.



• Turn talking-head videos, raw footage, scripts or images into polished social media content.



• Understand hooks, pacing, B-roll, captions, transitions, music, framing and storytelling.



• Work with tools such as Higgsfield, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar platforms.



AI and Modern Workflows



You should be comfortable working with modern AI tools and experimenting with new workflows.



Experience with some of the following is particularly valuable:



• ChatGPT

• Claude

• Claude Projects, Skills and Connectors

• Gemini

• Higgsfield

• HeyGen

• ElevenLabs

• AI agents

• MCP servers and MCP-based integrations

• APIs and cloud-based AI workflows



You do not need to know every platform already, but you should be interested in how AI tools can be connected and used in real marketing workflows.



Marketing Automation and Lead Generation



You should understand or be willing to work with tools such as:



• n8n

• Make

• Zapier

• Clay

• Apollo

• CRM systems

• APIs and webhooks



Typical workflows may include:



• Lead scraping and prospect research

• Lead enrichment and qualification

• LinkedIn prospecting and outreach preparation

• Content research and repurposing

• CRM updates

• Reporting

• AI-assisted research

• Marketing automation



You should also have a basic understanding of marketing funnels, customer journeys, landing pages, conversion opportunities and cross-channel marketing.



What We Are Looking For



Ideally you have 2+ years of practical experience in digital marketing, social media, content creation, video editing, AI workflows, automation or lead generation.



You should have:



• Strong understanding of social media and digital marketing

• Practical video editing skills

• Experience creating modern social media content

• A good visual eye

• Strong written English

• Understanding of marketing funnels and customer journeys

• Practical experience with AI tools

• Curiosity about new AI and marketing technologies

• Ability to work independently

• Strong organisation and ownership

• Commercial thinking rather than simply task execution



Experience with Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO, YouTube optimisation, CRM integrations, APIs or AI agents is an advantage.



You do not need to be an expert in every area.



We care more about whether you can learn quickly, connect ideas and understand how different marketing activities work together.



How We Work



We are looking for someone who:



• understands the objective behind a task

• takes ownership instead of waiting for detailed instructions

• combines creative thinking with commercial understanding

• understands audience pain points and customer behaviour

• thinks across multiple channels

• experiments with AI and emerging technologies

• looks for smarter workflows and automation opportunities

• can test ideas and improve based on performance



A question we want you to ask regularly is:



Can this be done better, faster or more intelligently?



Commitment and Compensation



• Remote position

• Approx. 6 hours per day

• Long-term cooperation

• Starting compensation: USD 400 per month

• Reliable overlap with Central European working hours, CET/CEST, is required



There is potential for increased responsibility and compensation over time based on performance and contribution.



How to Apply



Please include:



• A short introduction

• Your location and time zone

• Your availability and possible CET/CEST overlap

• Your social media and digital marketing experience

• Your video editing experience

• Your experience with AI-generated video

• Your experience with lead generation or LinkedIn prospecting

• Your experience with AI workflows and automation

• The tools you use regularly

• Your experience with Claude, Claude Skills, Connectors or MCP, if applicable

• Your experience with Higgsfield, if applicable



Portfolio Requirement



Please send at least 3 examples of work you personally created or played a significant role in creating.



Examples can include:



• Social media campaigns

• Reels or Shorts

• AI-generated video

• LinkedIn campaigns

• Lead-generation systems

• Marketing funnels

• Automation workflows

• AI workflows

• Social media graphics or carousels



For each example, briefly explain:



1. What was the objective?

2. What did you personally do?

3. Which tools did you use?

4. What was the result?

5. What would you improve if you built it again today?



Short Practical Challenge



Imagine we are working with a B2B consulting company.



The company wants to generate qualified leads through LinkedIn while also building stronger visibility through social media content.



We give you:



• a list of 500 potential companies

• several existing LinkedIn posts

• one 60-second talking-head video from the founder

• access to modern AI and automation tools



Briefly explain how you would turn this into a simple marketing system.



Please cover:



1. How would you research, enrich and qualify the right prospects?



2. How would you turn the 60-second video into a strong 20–30 second social media video?



3. How would LinkedIn content support the lead-generation activity?



4. Which parts would you automate using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, n8n, Make, MCP, APIs or other AI tools?



5. Which parts would you intentionally not automate?



6. Which 3 metrics would you monitor first to d
 whether the system is working?



There is no single correct answer.

title: Ad Researcher
description:
We’re looking for an ad researcher with a strong eye for direct response ads.



We run multiple brands and need someone to consistently find strong creative ideas for each one.



You’ll have access to BrandSearch & GetHookd, with thousands of ads to research**. It’s down to you to figure out which ads look promising, what makes them effective and which ideas would work well for our brands.



### What you’ll do



- Research ads from direct competitors and similar brands.

- Look across different verticals for ideas we could adapt.

- Identify strong hooks, angles, offers, demonstrations and formats.

- Save the best examples to our swipe file, organised by brand.

- Add a short explanation of why each ad is worth testing and how we could adapt it.

- Bring fresh ideas to our creative team every week.



We need someone who can make good decisions independently. Saving hundreds of random ads isn’t useful. Picking out the right ones and explaining why is.



### Who we’re looking for



- You have a good eye for ads and understand what makes people stop, watch and buy.

- You understand direct response advertising and proven creative patterns.

- You can spot ideas that would transfer well between products and industries.

- You can explain your thinking clearly.

- You’re organised and comfortable researching across multiple brands.

- You understand that an ad’s appearance or time running doesn’t automatically prove it’s profitable.



### How to apply



Send a short introduction, your relevant experience and **three ecommerce ads you think are strong**:



1. One video ad.

2. One static ad.

3. One ad from a different vertical whose approach could work for another brand.



Include the link and a few sentences explaining why you picked each ad, what makes it effective and what you would adapt.



We want to see your eye for creative and your judgement.

title: VICE PRESIDENT OF LOGISTICS
description:
VICE PRESIDENT OF LOGISTICS & OPERATIONS

SPRINTER | REMOTE | HOURLY FREELANCE / CONTRACT

Position: Vice President of Logistics & Operations / Head of Logistics

Company: SPRINTER | Concord Pacific Corp.

Location: 100% remote; qualified U.S. and international applicants welcome

Compensation: Hourly rate, based on experience | Long-term opportunity

Website: 

ABOUT SPRINTER

SPRINTER is developing a technology-enabled network for same-day and next-day city-to-city package delivery in the

United States. Its approach combines vetted drivers already traveling toward a package destination, dedicated delivery

drivers, planned retail drop-off and pickup locations, and secure reusable Smart Shipping Boxes.

Our initial technology platform has been developed. We are seeking an accomplished logistics leader to help design,

launch and scale the operational network, starting with selected California corridors.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We need an experienced, hands-on logistics executive - not simply an advisor. You will work directly with the

Founder & CEO to translate a high-potential logistics concept into reliable daily operations, measurable service quality

and a scalable nationwide model.

STRONGLY PREFERRED: UPS, FEDEX OR DHL EXPERIENCE

Strong preference will be given to candidates who previously held management, senior management or

executive positions with UPS, FedEx, DHL, or another major international parcel-delivery or logistics

organization. We especially value experience with large delivery networks, dispatch, fleet and driver operations,

distribution centers, route planning, operational controls and regional or national expansion. Former UPS, FedEx and

DHL operations leaders are strongly encouraged to apply.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Logistics network design: Develop California launch corridors, operational models, service areas, routing, capacity

plans and a roadmap for expansion across the United States.

• Same-day and next-day delivery: Establish SOPs covering package acceptance, pickup, dispatch, transportation,

tracking, delivery confirmation, exceptions and customer handoffs.

• Cutoff-time planning: Build operations around proposed 11:00 AM same-day and 5:00 PM next-day drop-off/pickup

cutoffs, validating feasibility by corridor before launch.

• Driver network: Design recruiting, vetting, onboarding, scheduling, performance management and service standards

for route-match drivers and dedicated SPRINTER drivers.

• Pickup and drop-off partnerships: Develop operating procedures and partner requirements for a planned network of

3,000+ nationwide retail locations; this network is a growth objective, not an existing footprint.

• Transportation economics: Evaluate cost per shipment, driver compensation, route density, vehicle utilization,

delivery time, operating expenses and profitability.

• Technology collaboration: Work with the product and engineering teams on driver-package matching, dispatch

workflows, tracking, proof of delivery, reporting and Smart Box integration.

SPRINTER | CONFIDENTIAL RECRUITMENT DRAFT 1

• Compliance and safety: Coordinate with legal/compliance specialists on transport regulations, insurance, driver

standards, package restrictions, claims and loss prevention.

• Team leadership: Recruit, train and manage dispatch coordinators, regional operations managers and transportation

partners as the business scales.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7-10+ years of progressively responsible experience in parcel delivery, courier networks, transportation, 3PL,

distribution or logistics operations.

• Demonstrated success launching, building, managing or expanding a delivery operation - preferably at regional or

national scale.

• Strong knowledge of dispatch, route optimization, driver operations, SOPs, cost controls, performance metrics and

service reliability.

• Understanding of U.S. transportation and logistics operations, even if working remotely from outside the United States.

• Excellent English communication, leadership, financial analysis, project management and independent execution

skills.

• Experience with technology-enabled logistics, on-demand delivery, two-sided marketplaces or driver networks is a

plus.

WHO WILL SUCCEED

A strategic but practical operator who can design a network, identify operational risks, build a launch plan, lead

execution, recruit capable people and produce measurable outcomes. We prefer professionals who have built or

launched logistics operations, not only supervised established teams.

WORK ARRANGEMENT & COMPENSATION

This is a fully remote, hourly paid freelance/contract position. Hours and hourly compensation will be agreed based

on experience, availability and responsibilities. The engagement may develop into a longer-term executive leadership

relationship as SPRINTER grows.

HOW TO APPLY ON 

Please review 
 before applying. Generic proposals will not be prioritized. In your application,

include:

• Your logistics background and the operations or delivery networks you have managed or built.

• Major-company experience: Whether you worked for UPS, FedEx, DHL or a comparable company; your job title,

dates, principal responsibilities and measurable accomplishments.

• A brief outline of how you would launch California same-day/next-day service, including Los Angeles-San Francisco

and Los Angeles-San Diego corridors.

• Your experience recruiting and managing drivers, dispatching shipments, developing SOPs and improving

transportation unit economics.

• Your weekly availability, hourly rate and examples of relevant results.

HELP BUILD THE FUTURE OF CITY-TO-CITY DELIVERY

SPRINTER is seeking a logistics leader who can help turn an innovative delivery model into a successful, reliable and

scalable national operation.

Roman Alexander

Founder & CEO

SPRINTER | CONFIDENTIAL RECRUITMENT DRAFT
salary: $1500 per month plus large bonus program

title: Remote Sales Closer

Full-time | Remote | US Central Time



ABOUT US

THE ROLE

You will run one-call discovery-and-close video calls with detailers who have applied through our ads. Our system books calls in your calendar for you and you have to attend every appointment on the calendar.

Your job:

- Run the call using our script and offer

- Close the sale and get payment started

- Update every lead in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- During no call slots, you will help with lead follow-ups, or no-show follow-ups.



You are an independent contractor, not an employee. You are responsible for your own taxes and government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG).

We expect you to attend to every booked call, and to update the CRM after every call.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Has experience working US Central time

- Clear, confident spoken English (A+)

- Real experience in customer sales closing video calls. Experience matters more than a title.

- Comfortable handling objections and saying no to a bad-fit client

- Reliable internet + Back-up internet, a quiet space, good computer and a good headset.

NICE TO HAVE

PAY

- Base: $300 per month for your first 60 days, then $250 per month

- Commission per close, paid after the client's first payment clears. Your total closes in the month set your rate, and that rate applies to ALL of your closes that month:

1 to 4 closes in a month: $200 each

5 to 8 closes in a month: $300 each

9 or more closes in a month: $350 each



Example: 9 closes = 9 x $350 = $3,150 in commission.



- Discretionary December bonus after 3 or more months

- Paid monthly through Wise. We cover the transfer fee.

Commission is reversed if the client refunds within 30 days of their first payment.



EXPECTATION:

A good candidate should be able to close AT LEAST 4 sales per month. Which would earn you $1,050/mo

An overperfomring candidate should be closing 9+ sales per month. Which would earn you $3,400/mo



GROWTH

Top performers can move up to a higher commission tier or a team lead role as we add closers.



HOW THE TRIAL WORKS

You start with a paid 30-day trial and a clear target we agree on in writing before you begin. We train you on the offer, the script and the CRM.



HOW TO APPLY

Send all of these with your application:

1. A 60-second video introducing yourself, in English and talk about your experience in remote closing sales video calls

2. Your Resume in pdf

3. If you've read the job description to this point, title your application message: "REMOTE".

Tentative schedule: Monday–Friday, 3:00–8:00 p.m. California time (America/Los_Angeles). Schedule flexibility after hiring may be mutually agreed in advance; changes are not unilateral. Trial dates and hours will be agreed before starting.



ABOUT THE ROLE



HoppScotch.bun is a growing rabbit-products brand looking for an experienced, hands-on e-commerce specialist to keep our stores, inventory, fulfillment, and customer operations running reliably.



You will work directly with the founder and alongside our marketing specialist. Our marketing specialist handles
 campaigns and social content; your primary responsibility is the operational side of the business.



We need someone who investigates problems, recommends practical solutions, follows through, and verifies the result—not someone who simply forwards problems to the founder.



WHAT YOU WILL MANAGE



Amazon operations and account health

• Monitor account-health notices, listing issues, inventory problems, and support cases.

• Investigate problems, identify deadlines, recommend corrective actions, and follow cases through resolution.

• Maintain accurate listings, variations, product information, and inventory records.



Shopify, inventory, and fulfillment

• Manage orders, SKU and variant accuracy, fulfillment locations, and inventory discrepancies.

• Work with Amazon FBA and Multi-Channel Fulfillment.

• Investigate unfulfilled orders, tracking problems, and overselling risks.

• Verify that changes and fulfillment requests worked correctly.



TikTok Shop setup and operations

• Support store setup and operational readiness in TikTok Shop Seller Center, with owner approval for account verification, integrations, and protected changes.

• Create and maintain accurate product listings, SKU/variant mappings, inventory, and fulfillment settings across TikTok Shop and our existing stores.

• Manage orders, dispatch and tracking issues, returns requests, customer inquiries, account-health notices, and support cases within approved policies.

• Coordinate product availability and shop-ready information with our marketing specialist, who retains ownership of social content and publishing.



Customer service

• Manage authorized customer-service queues across our stores and communication channels.

• Research order history before responding and keep customers informed.

• Follow approved policies and escalate decisions with complete context.



Product research and supplier coordination

• Research useful products for rabbit owners using our direction, customer feedback, and reliable sources.

• Compare specifications, supplier quotes, minimum quantities, lead times, and landed costs.

• Prepare clear recommendations supported by calculations—not invented sales projections.

• Follow up with suppliers and maintain organized records.



ManyChat and operational systems

• Diagnose customer-journey and connection problems, conduct controlled tests, and coordinate with our marketing specialist.

• Maintain concise documentation and clear handoffs.



Daily accountability

• Record time in ClickUp.

• Keep active task comments current and submit an end-of-day update after every shift.

• Explain completed work, evidence, blockers, next steps, and any decision needed.



These responsibilities form the intended ongoing role. Priorities will be planned within the agreed paid hours.



WHAT YOU SHOULD BRING



• Hands-on Amazon Seller Central AND Shopify experience is required.

• Practical experience with inventory, fulfillment, order exceptions, and customer service.

• Hands-on TikTok Shop Seller Center experience is strongly preferred; describe the setup, catalog, inventory, order, or account-health work you have personally handled.

• Two or more years of relevant e-commerce operations experience is preferred.

• Confidence using spreadsheets for reconciliation and clearly explained calculations.

• Strong written communication and independent research habits.

• Supplier coordination and product-research experience.

• ManyChat troubleshooting experience is a strong advantage; accurately describe your level.

• Familiarity with rabbits or pet products is helpful, along with a willingness to research carefully.



Experience should come from real operational work, not only courses or general familiarity with the platforms.



HOW WE WORK



Research available instructions and reliable documentation before escalating a searchable question. When a decision or authorization is needed, explain the issue, what you checked, your recommendation, and the exact action required.



Follow the agreed schedule and request changes in advance. Spending, refunds, pricing changes, purchases, and protected live-system changes require approval.



HOW TO APPLY



Include BURROW READY in your first paragraph and provide:



1. Your resume and a brief summary of your Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop, fulfillment, product-research, and ManyChat experience.

2. One real inventory, fulfillment, or account-health problem you personally resolved: what happened, what you did, and how you verified the outcome.

3. One existing, redacted work example, such as an inventory report, operational SOP, listing audit, or support-case record. Remove all confidential information.

4. Your earliest start date, available working hours, current work commitments, and whether the $7.50 starting rate works for you.



Keep your application relevant and concise. No new video or lengthy unpaid project is required.



Shortlisted applicants will have an interview followed by a 15-hour paid trial. Authorized onboarding, training, research, meetings, and documentation count toward those paid hours. Continued work depends on demonstrated performance and business needs. The starting rate remains $7.50/hour if work continues; no automatic increase is promised.

title: SMS Campaign Manager – International Marketing Company (US Health & Wellness Clients)
description:
ABOUT US

We are an international marketing company. We work as an agency for big health and wellness clients in the US, and we run their offers, funnels, traffic and customer messaging.



SMS is a big part of what we do for these clients. Now we need one person who owns the day-to-day sending and makes the numbers better every week.



THE ROLE

You will manage promotional SMS campaigns for our US health and wellness clients, sent to subscribers who opted in. Everything technical is already in place: the client brands are registered and approved, the sending routes are set up, and we have built our own sending dashboard. You don't need to be a developer.



What you will do:

- Log in every day and run several campaigns at once, across different clients and routes

- Set the limits and caps in our dashboard, d
 how fast to send, and when to slow down, pause or push more volume

- Plan when each send goes out: which days, which times, how volume is spread through the day

- Watch delivery, clicks, opt-outs, complaints and errors, and act fast when something drops

- Understand what we are sending, who we are sending it to, and where the link goes (the funnel after the click)

- Run and improve our AI-first copy process. We use AI tools to write and test SMS copy, and you d
 what goes out and what wins

- Send a short daily report with the numbers and what you would change tomorrow

- Tell us what our dashboard is missing. If you have used other SMS platforms, we want your ideas



MUST HAVE

- You have personally managed SMS campaigns sent to the US market (not only
, not only the Philippines)

- You can show real numbers from campaigns you ran (sent, delivered, clicks, opt-outs)

- Strong with numbers and spreadsheets

- Clear written English. You will be working on messages for Americans



NICE TO HAVE

- SMS for US health, wellness or supplement brands. This is the person we are really looking for

- Postscript, Klaviyo, Attentive or similar SMS work for US e-commerce brands (even one client counts)

- Running many campaigns at the same time across different routes or providers

- Experience with 10DLC or toll-free sending and carrier filtering

- Using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) in your daily work

- SMS for other US industries (real estate, appointment setting, lead follow-up, etc.). Tell us exactly what you did

- OnlineJobs IQ test on your profile



WHAT WE OFFER

- Starting at USD 1,200/month full time (40 hrs/week). Part time is also OK, paid pro rata

- This is a starting rate. If you are a rock star in this niche, there is a lot more on the table, and pay grows with results and volume

- Long-term, remote, working with big US brands

- We provide all tools, accounts and offers



HOW TO APPLY (please read, we skip applications that don't follow this)

1. Start your application with the word GREENLIGHT

2. Answer these two questions in your own words, short is fine:

   a) Which countries and industries were your SMS campaigns for, and roughly how many messages went out on your busiest day?

   b) Paste one promotional SMS you sent, exactly as it went out, and tell us what happened after it went out (clicks, sales, opt-outs, anything you remember).

3. Tell us full time or part time, your available hours, and your monthly rate.



No voice notes or calls at this stage. We read written answers first.



Sabine Sarney

Recruiter

title: High-Ticket Enrollment Closer
description:
We are hiring 10 proven high-ticket closers.



We are a science-based relationship transformation company. Our clients are financially successful

women (founders, executives, physicians, attorneys) who have built everything except the partnership they want. Our methodology helps them identify and clear the patterns standing in

the way. Our enrollment conversations are deep, discreet and high-trust. They are also high-ticket.



This role is for a hunter. 



You don’t wait for a full calendar. Our setters and AI assistant book qualified calls for you, and you also work a database of approximately 120,000 contacts to find the opportunities everyone else missed. You book them, close them and collect.



Top performers get top leads. Lead access is earned by results. Our most qualified inbound

opportunities go to our highest-level closers.



You must have:



• Completed a recognized high-ticket sales training program, such as SheSells or an equivalent. You’ll tell us which one and show us how you use it.



• A proven record closing high-ticket offers of $5,000 or more on consultative calls. Bring your

numbers: calls taken, close rate and cash collected.



• Self-starter drive. You prospect, book and close in the same role.



• The integrity to qualify hard. We would rather lose a sale than enroll the wrong client.



• Disciplined CRM habits and an appetite for coaching: daily role-play, recorded calls and weekly call

review.



• Speed. New leads hear from you within minutes, not hours.



• Strongly preferred: experience selling to women, or in coaching, wellness or personal development.



How you’ll be paid:



• Months 1–3 (ramp): 10% commission on cash collected, plus any wages required by law.



• Weekly bonuses from week one: hit $50,000, $75,000, $100,000 or $150,000 in upfront cash in a

week and earn a $250 to $2,000 bonus, plus surprise rewards for top performers.



• Weekly ramp targets: Month 1, $40,000 collected. Month 2, $70,000. Month 3, $100,000, with 15

qualified bookings.



• Hit your ramp and you enter our 12-level Closer Ladder: a monthly base that grows at every level,

plus 10–12% commission that never goes down as you climb.



• At our $100,000-a-week target (Level 7), plan pay is about $50,800 a month. Our top level pays a

$15,000 monthly base plus 12% commission.



• Leadership track: lead a pod of closers for an override, then move into Sales Manager at a $100,000 base plus 1% of your team’s collected cash.



How we promote:



Every month, on your trailing 12-week results: collected cash, qualified bookings, show rate, chargeback

rate and CRM quality. No politics and no tenure clock. Produce, and you move up.



To apply:



Send your résumé, the name of the high-ticket program you completed, and your last 90 days of results

(calls, close rate and cash collected, with no client names). Shortlisted candidates complete a live

discovery-and-close role-play.

THE ROLE IN ONE SENTENCE

You find active real estate agents, build a real relationship with them on Instagram, and book their next photo shoot with me.



ROLE OVERVIEW

You will run Instagram outreach, lead nurture and booking for my real estate photography business in Southern California (
). This is Instagram only and outbound only. You will not post content or handle inbound inquiries. You will follow a warm outreach method: engagement first, DM second. We never cold blast.



You MUST have experience with the REPP method, Eli Jones's outreach method, or outreach for a real estate photography or media company. Applicants without this experience will not be considered.



THE OFFER

WHO QUALIFIES

An agent qualifies only if they:

- Work in Riverside County (Inland Empire) or Orange County

- Have at least 5 listings in the last 12 months, confirmed on their 
 agent profile

- Are booking a residential listing (house, condo or townhome)

Do not contact, offer the free video to, or book anyone who does not meet all three.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Build the Agent List

- Use 
 to find agents who qualify

- Add every agent to a Google Sheet: name, Instagram handle, brokerage, city, listings in the last 12 months



2. Instagram Outreach

- Follow each agent on the list

- Watch their recent listing posts and reels and leave 1 or 2 real, specific comments. Never "great post"

- Engage with their content for 1 to 2 weeks before any DM

- Then send a personalized DM offering a free vertical video with their first shoot

- Send 10 to 15 quality DMs per day. Every DM is written for that agent. Never copy and paste

- Follow my approved DM format exactly. It works, so don't change it

- Update the Google Sheet for every agent: date followed, date commented, date DM'd, reply, follow up date



3. Booking

- When an agent is ready to book, collect the property address, square footage, date and

- Book the shoot in Spiro yourself using my standard package pricing, with the free vertical video added. Never send the agent a booking link

- Double check every booking: correct address, date, package and add-ons

- Send me every booking on WhatsApp right away so I can confirm my schedule

- Never offer discounts or anything besides the free vertical video



4. Follow Up

- Run a 60 to 90 day follow up cycle for agents who said no or didn't reply

- Reach back out when they post a new listing, never with a generic "checking in"



5. Inbox

- Check Instagram DMs every shift

- Reply only to agents you contacted first. Handle those conversations from first DM through booking, in a friendly, helpful tone using my approved templates

- Do not reply to anyone who messaged me first, such as new inquiries, past clients or anyone you have not contacted. Forward those to me on WhatsApp within 1 hour

- Send me anything you are not sure about on WhatsApp within 1 hour, including pricing questions outside my standard packages, commercial properties and complaints



6. Daily Reports

- Start of day WhatsApp message with your plan

- End of day WhatsApp message with counts: agents added, comments, DMs sent, replies received, shoots booked



WORK RULES

- Start and end at your agreed time every day

- Clock in and out using the time tracker I provide. It only runs while you are clocked in

- All daily tasks must be complete before you clock out

- Only do the tasks listed here. If you think something else needs doing, ask me first

- Only bill for time you actually worked

- You may use AI tools like Claude to help draft, but every message must follow my format and read like a real person wrote it. No robotic, salesy or AI sounding messages

- Never post content or delete comments on my account



REQUIREMENTS

- Required: experience with the REPP method, Eli Jones's outreach method, or Instagram outreach for a real estate photography or media company

- Proven results from warm Instagram outreach (replies, booked calls or booked clients)

- Writes short, natural messages that sound like a real person texting, not a robot or AI

- Strong customer service skills. Friendly, patient and professional with every agent

- Experience with Spiro or a similar booking system. If you've used a different one, that counts and I will train you on Spiro

- Follows scripts and instructions exactly and asks when unsure

- Detail oriented and organized, comfortable with Google Sheets

- WhatsApp for daily communication

- Reliable internet plus a backup internet connection and backup power



NICE TO HAVE

- Real estate industry experience

- US client experience

- Experience using Claude or other AI tools for business writing



SCHEDULE

15 hours per week, Monday to Friday. You choose a 3 hour daily window between 7am and 2pm Pacific Time and keep it consistent.



PAY

$5 per hour USD, plus a $10 bonus for every shoot you book with a qualified agent once the shoot is completed. Paid weekly via Wise. The first week is a paid trial.



GROWTH

This is long-term work with a growing business. Hours increase in spring, and this role can grow into a full-time position as the business grows. The right person can also move into an outreach lead role over time.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Record a 1 to 2 minute video in English with your face on camera. Start by saying:

"Hi Abidur, I'm applying for the Instagram outreach role at Vista Media Homes."

Then tell me who you are and walk me through an Instagram outreach conversation you ran that turned into a reply or booking.

Upload it to Loom, Google Drive or unlisted YouTube, and make sure anyone with the link can view it.



2. In your application, include:

- The words "VISTA OUTREACH" at the top of your message so I know you read the whole post

- Your video link

- Which method you have used: REPP, Eli Jones, or outreach for a real estate photography or media company. Who was it for, how long, and what results did you get?

- What booking system or CRM you have used, and whether you have used Spiro

- One DM you would send to a real estate agent after engaging with their listing reels, offering a free vertical video with their first shoot. Write it like a real person texting

- Rewrite this message so it sounds natural and human: "Hello, I am reaching out to offer you our professional real estate media services. We would be happy to assist you with your listing needs. Please let me know if you are interested."

- A screenshot of a speed test from this week, plus your backup internet and backup power



Applications without a video, or that skip a step, will not be reviewed.

title: Outbound Calling & Email Outreach (Healthcare / Home Care)
description:
Who we are



We are a healthcare and residential services company in Houston, Texas. We operate group homes and a home care agency. Our growth depends on consistent outreach to the people who refer patients to us: hospital discharge planners, case managers, and social workers.



The role



This is a high-volume outbound calling role. The target is 100 dials per day from a list we provide. You will be calling US healthcare professionals, including discharge planners, case managers, social workers, facility staff, and home care prospects. Log every call outcome, book callbacks, and pass warm leads to our US team.



Schedule

Night shift, covering US Central business hours. Confirm exact hours before posting (approx. 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM Philippine time). The schedule is fixed. No rotating shifts.



Pay



	•	Starting pay: $4.50 per hour

	•	Increases to $5.50 per hour after 4 weeks of training

	•	Paid hourly for time worked, with each hour tracked for call activity, duration, and quality

	•	Compensation reflects tracked call quality



How we track work



Every hour you work must show measurable activity. We track call count, call duration, and call quality through our phone monitoring system (Quo). All calls are recorded and reviewed.



What you must have



	•	Prior cold calling experience. This is not an entry-level position. Applicants without experience will not be considered.



	•	Excellent spoken English. You will speak with American healthcare professionals for hours every day. Clear, confident, and easy to understand.



	•	Proven high call volume in a previous role



	•	Stable internet (please state your speed), a noise-cancelling headset, and a quiet, private room



	•	Willingness to work the night shift consistently, long term



Nice to have, not required



	•	Experience calling US healthcare, home health, or residential care



Training



	•	Paid training first 4 weeks

	•	Call outs are not permitted during training weeks. Anyone who makes a call out during training will be terminated.

	•	Starting pay applies during training, with the increase after 4 weeks



Equipment and connectivity



You are responsible for your own equipment and internet connection. Time lost to equipment or Wi-Fi problems is not paid. 







	•	Live interview on Zoom. Open interview date: Tuesday, October 13

	•	Candidates must answer on their own. Using AI tools to answer interview questions will disqualify you.

	•	Recording and monitoring consent is required before start



How to apply



Start your application with the word HOUSTON so we know you read this posting fully. Applications without it will not be reviewed. Please send:



	•	Your resume

	•	A 60-second voice recording (Vocaroo link is fine) with your name, your cold calling background, and the most calls you have made in one day

	•	One sentence on why night shift works for you



We reply to every serious applicant. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a live Zoom interview.

title: Full Time - Lead Generation, B2B Sales | Hard Working and Smart Only.
description:
ABOUT US

We’re a growing exporter of frozen seafood, selling by the container to importers and distributors around the world. We’re looking for one sharp, dedicated person to find new buyers and open doors for our sales team. This is a long-term role with room to grow into sales as the business expands.



For ASIA Market (China, Japan, Korea, Thailand, Vietnam, etc)

Experience in any of these markets or languages is highly valued.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



Research and identify companies that import and distribute seafood in our target countries

Find the right decision-makers (buyers, purchasing managers, owners) and their contact details

Reach out by
, LinkedIn and WhatsApp with professional, personalized messages

Follow up consistently and book calls between qualified buyers and our team

Keep our lead tracker organized and up to date

Report weekly on contacts found, conversations started and meetings booked



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



Experience in B2B lead generation, appointment setting or outreach (1+ year preferred)

Excellent written English. You’ll be writing to business owners and buyers.

Comfortable with LinkedIn, Google Sheets and finding information online

Organized, self-driven and able to work without constant supervision

Reliable internet and a backup (mobile data or second connection) for outages

Looking for one long-term employer, not juggling several clients



No experience with this exact job title? If you’ve done online research, outreach or sales support and you learn fast, apply anyway.



NICE TO HAVE



Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar tools

Experience selling to importers, distributors or wholesale buyers

Any background in food, export or logistics

Market knowledge or language



WHAT WE OFFER



$600–800/month based on experience

Bonuses for every qualified buyer meeting you book

A bigger bonus for every deal closed from your leads

Paid twice a month

Long-term, stable role with real growth for the right person



DETAILS



Full-time, 40+ hours/week, Monday to Friday

Flexible schedule, with a few hours of overlap with our team for check-ins

Remote, independent contractor

First 30 days are a paid trial with clear targets

Start: ASAP



HOW TO APPLY (READ CAREFULLY)

We only review applications that follow ALL of these steps:



Start your message with the word OCEAN.

Answer this in your own words, no AI: If you had to find companies that import frozen seafood into a country you’ve never worked with, how would you do it? Explain your approach in 3–5 sentences.

Send a 1-minute voice or video recording introducing yourself and your most relevant result for a past client (for example, meetings booked or leads found).

Tell us your expected monthly salary.



Applications missing any step will not be reviewed.
